title: Verb て いく (Verb-te iku)
shortExplanation: Expresses an action that continues on into the future or a change that progresses over time.
longExplanation: The て いく grammar point is used to indicate that an action will continue or a change will progress into the future. It can be attached to the て-form of a verb and is often translated as 'to keep', 'to continue', or 'to go on' in English.

examples.jp: このまま練習を続けていくと、上達するでしょう。
examples.romaji: Kono mama renshuu o tsuzukete iku to, joutatsu suru deshou.
examples.en: If you keep practicing like this, you will improve.

examples.jp: 彼は成長していくうちに、自立心が強くなった。
examples.romaji: Kare wa seichou shite iku uchi ni, jiritsushin ga tsuyoku natta.
examples.en: As he grew up, his independence became stronger.

examples.jp: この会社はこれからも技術革新を行っていくでしょう。
examples.romaji: Kono kaisha wa korekara mo gijutsu kakushin o okonatte iku deshou.
examples.en: This company will continue to innovate in technology in the future.

examples.jp: 子供たちはどんどん学んでいく。
examples.en: Children will keep learning more and more.
